name: mpdantic
description: Audits and repairs a music library for MPD: output buffer sizing by RAM, .mpdignore management, CUE sheet repair, playlist rebasing, tag validation. Rust core, thin Node shell.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Pedantic about your library, so MPD does not choke on it. Audits and repairs a music library for MPD, folder by folder, from its own management pages on the player. Those pages are open to the player's network, as Volumio's own are: anyone who can reach the player can read and write the library from them; every write is undoable. After each write Volumio rebuilds its album list, which takes a while on a large library.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.3 Fourth test cut: each check-report code opens the findings work list on that code; with a code chip on, findings are a paginated file table with dismiss, clickable path and bulk dismiss; tag repair cards list only files that change by default.
